race.comment: MISTER SELFIE (2) is a two-time winner over this trip and is much better than the recent effort suggests. Can bounce back. ULUWATU (1) boasts a win around this circuit, gets 3kg off with the claim and draws the inside marble. Ticks a few boxes. UPSTART LOVER (5) rounds out the selections. WATER LAD (8) has found form and finds a nice race to keep the ball rolling. Not taking lightly.
